summary.intent: Execute Phase 35 (Phala Testnet TEE Migration) using the GSD wave-based parallel execution workflow across 6 plans and 4 waves.
summary.outcome: Wave 1 (plan 35-01) completed successfully — TEE worker restructured into apps/tee-worker/ with shared monorepo package integration. A merge conflict in STATE.md was encountered and resolved after merging the agent worktree back to the phase branch.

repo: Phase 35 is on branch `phase-35-phala-testnet-tee-migration` in a git worktree, not the main repo checkout — gsd-tools must be invoked from the worktree path, not the main repo path
Phase 35 has 6 plans across 4 waves: Wave 1 (35-01 structural refactor), Wave 2 (35-02/03 tests + Phala SDK), Wave 3 (35-04/05 staging + docs), Wave 4 (35-06 CVM deployment checkpoint)
TEE worker was originally at root level; Phase 35 moves it to apps/tee-worker/ and replaces local reimplementations with @cipherbox/crypto, @cipherbox/core, @cipherbox/sdk-core shared packages
workflow: gsd-tools init execute-phase must be run from the correct working directory (worktree) — running from main repo returns phase_found: false even when the phase exists
Agent worktree merges can produce STATE.md conflicts when both orchestrator and executor agent update it; the agent's version should be taken as authoritative
Wave 1 executor agent used --no-verify on commits (parallel execution mode) — post-wave hook validation is required before proceeding to Wave 2

friction: gsd-tools init returned phase_found: false because it was invoked from the main repo instead of the worktree — required manual branch/directory investigation to diagnose
Merge conflict in STATE.md after merging agent worktree required manual conflict resolution
open_items: Waves 2–4 (plans 35-02 through 35-06) not yet executed — session ended after Wave 1
Plan 35-06 is a checkpoint plan (autonomous: false) requiring human interaction for the Phala Cloud CVM deployment
Post-wave hook validation for Wave 1 (--no-verify commits) should be confirmed before Wave 2 spawns
